summary: The source contract permits only one or two bounded integer arguments, so serialization has constant bounded work and each wrapper call performs one expected constant-time map lookup, with source evaluation occurring only on a cache miss.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The supported factorial and fib functions take one integer, while sum takes exactly two bounded integers.

replacement_checks.evidence: Every legal tuple contains at most two bounded integers, so JSON key construction and one expected map access require constant bounded work.
Cases cover both arities, swapped ordered pairs, zero-valued results, numeric boundaries, repeated expensive calls, and several distinct cache entries.
